parsed.post: Discarding recent experiment (1.0458) as it slightly regressed from our best (1.0447). It seems the combination was slightly unstable. Reverting to 4952c54. Next, I'll try reducing MATRIX_LR slightly to 0.04 to see if it provides more stable convergence with the current warmup/batch setup.
